oneLine: A concept note and funding proposal to close Rwanda's youth sexual-health access gap with one private kit and two delivery tracks.
outcome: Rwanda's young people know where to get tested. Most still don't. SRB is a concept note and funding proposal to close that gap.
status: Concept note circulating to funders; none secured yet
